title: Proposed study collaboration on SYT2-related myasthenic syndromes

sentences.text: Invitation to discuss a research collaboration on SYT2-related presynaptic congenital myasthenic syndromes

Dear Muscular Dystrophy Association team, your association works across neuromuscular diseases, including congenital myasthenic syndromes, though the atlas link to the SYT2 community is a partnership signal rather than a formal record.
I am [name, role, institution], and I would value your view on a study idea.
Published work links these syndromes to loss of function, and a dominant-negative effect is proposed for dominant variants but not directly tested.
The Congenital Muscle Disease International Registry includes people with this condition.
A completed amifampridine trial studied congenital myasthenic syndromes, and amifampridine and pyridostigmine have been investigated for SYT2-related disorders.
We would propose [study aim and design], built with families and run under ethics approval.

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be willing to discuss the idea, and how your community or the registry could take part with proper consent?
We are not asking for any names, contact details or records of patients or families.
If you are open to it, could we arrange a short call?
